usage: capture_standalone_interface.py [-h] --exe EXE --source-root
                                       SOURCE_ROOT --build-root BUILD_ROOT
                                       --source-qualification
                                       SOURCE_QUALIFICATION
                                       --expected-exe-sha256
                                       EXPECTED_EXE_SHA256 --output OUTPUT
                                       --dummy-sdl [--include-header-aspects]
                                       [--timeout-seconds TIMEOUT_SECONDS]

Capture thirteen real native interface views into a new, bounded gallery.
--include-header-aspects appends two unequal-aspect Dimensional Play views,
1920x820 and 1400x1080, for a fifteen-view gallery. The default stays
thirteen. Requires Python 3.10+, Pillow, an already built standalone and a
source/build qualification JSON with ``binary_sha256`` and ``source_sha256``
members. The qualification is checked, not treated as an independent build
attestation. SDL dummy audio/video and the software renderer must be
explicitly admitted. This utility never builds, changes application sources,
saves controls, uses image generation, overwrites a gallery, or substitutes
artwork for app pixels.

options:

  --source-root SOURCE_ROOT
  --build-root BUILD_ROOT
  --source-qualification SOURCE_QUALIFICATION
                        author report with binary_sha256 and source_sha256;
                        every listed digest must match
  --expected-exe-sha256 EXPECTED_EXE_SHA256
  --output OUTPUT       new directory; an existing empty directory is refused
  --dummy-sdl           acknowledge dummy audio/video and software rendering;
                        no physical device claim
  --include-header-aspects
                        append full-frame 1920x820 and 1400x1080 Dimensional
                        Play views (15 total; default 13)
  --timeout-seconds TIMEOUT_SECONDS
